│
│      Review changes on two independent axes, specification compliance and engineering quality, including layering, SOLID, domain invariants, security, test coverage and unnecessary complexity.
│
│    evidence-verification
│
│      Independently verify a feature against requirements, BDD acceptance scenarios, approved domain/data design, architecture, automated tests and operational checks using executed evidence.
│

│
│      Deeply interview stakeholders about feature ideas, product rules and engineering design while reading repository documentation, maintaining domain vocabulary and surfacing ambiguities before implementation.
│
│    implementation-planning
│
│      Convert approved specs and technical design into concise test-first vertical slices with explicit code organization, Clean Code, SOLID, dependency direction, layers, interfaces and verification tasks.
│
│    lean-engineer
│
│      Orchestrate a lightweight architecture-first software engineering lifecycle across requirements, BDD, C4/cloud design, detailed technical design, implementation, testing and evidence verification. Use for end-to-end feature delivery or choosing which Lean Engineering skill comes next.
│
│    requirements-engineering
│
│      Turn a clarified feature idea into precise functional and non-functional requirements, business rules, scope, traceable IDs and measurable quality constraints before architecture or coding.
│
│    solution-architecture
│
│      Review and design C4, cloud and domain-level solution architecture using DDIA principles, explicit quality drivers, system boundaries, data ownership, alternatives and ADRs.
│
│    test-driven-development
│
│      Implement approved software changes with red-green-refactor, domain unit tests, real integration tests, critical E2E workflows, regression checks and representative AI evaluations.
